about: The merge lanes' path lists. Read by scripts/lane-classify.mjs. Lane 1 is plain-writing files only: the plan, the log and markdown under docs/. Test files anywhere are lane 3. A file is matched against lane 3 first, then lane 2, then lane 1; a file on no list is lane 3. A pull request takes its highest file's lane. This file is itself lane 3.
